chapter: Return to Basie and leaving in 1948
title: Leaving Basie: back in March 1946, gone in 1948
summary: Jones dates his Army service from September 1944, his return in March 1946, and his leaving Basie in 1948.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: When did you leave Basie's band, Jo? How long did you stay there?
I went in the Army, you know.
You went in the Army in '44.

This is where we got back to where we were before. When you came out of the Army in '44 I was with Cab in Omaha and you came and just sat in with us and Buford Oliver was there, so we just made a complete cycle now, a circle. All this had happened; then you went back to Basie.
March of '46. And you stayed until when?
I stayed with Mr. Basie till 1948. I left.
Then you went on your own?
